module.name: @MODULE_NAME@
module.author: OpenMRS
module.description: Interactive lab test summary report, broken down by category, test, age group and gender, with drill-down to the patients behind each count

globalProperty.description: Comma-separated concept uuids of the stock adjustment reasons that represent routine consumption rather than an error correction. The Stock Adjustments report uses these to tell the two uses of an Adjustment apart: drawing down a non-drug commodity that has no dispensing workflow, versus correcting a miscount on a drug. Reasons not listed here count as corrections. Leave empty to classify everything as a correction, in which case no mismatch flags are raised.

Notification bell: comma-separated role names (e.g. Organizational: Doctor) whose users are notified when a lab test result is entered, in addition to the provider who ordered the test, who is always notified.
Notification bell: comma-separated role names whose users are notified when a lab test is ordered. Leave empty to notify no one.
Notification bell: comma-separated role names (e.g. pharmacy staff) whose users are notified when a medication is ordered. Leave empty to notify no one.
Notification bell: comma-separated role names whose users are notified when a patient is registered. Leave empty to notify no one.

Notification bell: who is notified when a patient is added to a service queue that is not waiting for a specific provider (a queue entry waiting for a provider notifies only that provider). Comma-separated entries, each either a role name (notified for every queue) or "Queue name=Role name", e.g. "Pharmacy=Inventory Dispensing,Doctor Room 1=Organizational: Doctor".

Daily closing time (24-hour HH:mm, in labtestreport.autoCloseVisits.timezone) at which every still-open visit is ended, which also takes those patients out of the service queues. Leave empty to disable.
IANA timezone id (e.g. Asia/Gaza) that labtestreport.autoCloseVisits.time is expressed in. Daylight saving is handled automatically.
